about: What a rep or manager is told when Hi-Tech moves an item's delivery date. Decided 13 Nov 2026, the user's team: production can still move a line's promised date in Hi-Tech after the order is placed, and the rep who quoted the old date needs to know before the customer does.
the_field: custom_sap_ship_date (manna_sap_status.py, Sales Order Item): Hi-Tech's own ShipDate (RDR1, not the order header's DocDueDate - the comment on sap-b1if/status/status_hitech.sql says why that is the only place a single item's date can be), sent only while the line is still Open in SAP. A blank is itself the news - it means the line has closed and nothing in SAP can move it again.
why_a_device_diff_not_a_push: Same reasoning as stage_watch.json: Notification Log grants role All read but not create, so a rep's or manager's login cannot write one over the API, and there are no Server Script hooks that fire on a sync write. So each device remembers the date it last showed per line, and the difference on the next look is the news.
three_kinds_of_news: A blank-to-date is the line becoming plannable, or the first look catching a move that happened earlier. A date-to-another-date is Hi-Tech moving it again. A date-to-blank is the line closing - read as `closed: true`, worded differently because it is not a date to show, it is the fact that nothing will move it again.
not_the_order_header: This is not delivery_date (what the rep promised the customer) or custom_original_delivery_date (the order's own unwired 'it moved' marker - see order_detail_screen.dart's _deliveryMoved, which nothing currently writes). Rolling several lines' dates up into one header figure needs a rule for which line wins, and delivery_date already drives pick-list timing - a separate decision, not made by this fixture.

cases.why: never opened here before - establishes the baseline, reports nothing
a date appearing where there was none - the line became plannable, or this is the first look to catch the move
hi-tech moved it again - reported as a plain move
the line closed - a blank is the news, read as closed, not as a move to nothing
a line added since the baseline was taken is not a change to an old one
